description: Builds the app again from the latest commit of its repository (or its last upload) and deploys it when the build passes. Use after a failed build, or to ship new commits when auto-deploy is off. One build per app at a time; limits on builds running and builds per hour; a refusal says when to try again. Poll get_app_status.

app_id.description: The app id returned by list_apps

name: rebuild_app
title: Build an app again
